info.name: SocialNetwork API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Pet_VK Social Network project.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT token. Register or Login first — test scripts auto-save tokens to environment variables.

**Collection-level pre-request script** sets the Authorization header from `{{accessToken}}` for all non-Auth requests.

exec: // Collection-level pre-request: ensure Authorization header is set
